# Starrfield Fun

Starrfield Fun is a portfolio of Starr, a UI/UX designer and developer.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://starrfieldfun.com/): introduction and selected work.
- [Work](https://starrfieldfun.com/work/): five design and development case studies.
- [About](https://starrfieldfun.com/about/): background and capabilities.
- [Photography](https://starrfieldfun.com/photography/): editorial image gallery and colour correction.
- [Contact](https://starrfieldfun.com/contact/): contact form.

- [MyBusFinder](https://starrfieldfun.com/bus-finder/)
- [Monitor Control](https://starrfieldfun.com/monitor-control/)
- [PromptChecker](https://starrfieldfun.com/promptchecker/)
- [Singapore National Paralympics Council](https://starrfieldfun.com/snpc/)
